g.text: Test set, headline runs (320 runs, 2092 windows). Error bars: 95% CI, resampled by run. Right panel: the 740 windows with no fault active (CI shown for the deployed detector only).

g.text: Isolation Forest is shown as a warning, not a result: it was kept out of the live path because it cannot tell healthy windows from faulty ones.
